senses.gloss:
f. (-का)
A courtezan, (in theatrical language.)
E.
अज to go, or here, to gain, and उकन् affix; sometimes read अर्ज्जुका, from अर्ज to earn, to gain.

f. (-जूः)
Working without wages.
E.
आङ्, जुर् to become old, क्विप् affix; also आजू.

f. (-जूः)
See the preceding.
E.
आङ्, जु to be quick, क्विप् affix, and the final lengthened; or जन to be born, and डू aff.
